scope: Optional Phase-1b confirmation of the preregistered signal-only I32 endpoint. This does not alter the active Phase-1 I8 selection, cannot rescue a failed Phase-1 gate, and does not authorize an automatic launch.

known: Seed-42 I0, I8, I16, and I32 training and six-benchmark results.
I8 is the preregistered mixed candidate selected for Phase-1 multi-seed confirmation.
I32 has the highest seed-42 macro Avg@k and positive deltas on all six benchmarks, but was preregistered as ineligible for Phase-1 candidate selection.
unobserved: All seed-43 and seed-44 six-benchmark evaluation results for I0 and I8.
All seed-43 and seed-44 I32 training and evaluation results.

rationale: The seed-42 ordering I32 > I8 > I0 > I16 leaves the necessity of the random complement unresolved. A later I32 confirmation must be specified before held-out evaluation results, while remaining separate from the original Phase-1 candidate-selection claim.

launch_policy.earliest_launch: Only after the active Phase-1 controller terminates and all I0/I8 seeds 42/43/44 records pass their formal verifiers and frozen gates.
do_not_launch_if: The active controller or any provenance-locked Phase-1 process is still running.
Either seed-43 or seed-44 I0 baseline records are missing or unverified.
There is insufficient capacity for the fixed checkpoint-retention protocol.
The experiment owner decides that matched standard LoRA is the higher-priority use of compute.

fixed_method.signal_source: The same immutable P2 subspace used by seed-42 I32; no refit, rotation, reselection, or seed-dependent signal construction is allowed.

i8_vs_i32_mechanism_comparison.role: Secondary confirmatory comparison; never retroactively changes the original Phase-1 selector.
required_outputs: Per-seed exactly matched paired problem-bootstrap comparisons for seeds 42, 43, and 44.
i8_vs_i32_mechanism_comparison.no_directional_claim: If neither symmetric held-out gate passes, report both methods without claiming that the random complement or signal-only endpoint is superior.

claim_policy.if_original_i8_phase1_fails: The original Phase-1 method fails. A later I32 pass is a separate post-selection Phase-1b result and must not be presented as rescuing or satisfying the original I8 gate.
claim_policy.if_i8_passes_and_i32_fails: I8 is the stable Phase-1 method; the random complement remains a plausible contributor, but a direct benefit claim additionally requires the I8-minus-I32 mechanism gate.
claim_policy.if_i8_fails_and_i32_passes: I32 is a separately confirmed signal-only follow-up candidate. The paper must disclose seed-42 endpoint observation before Phase-1b and cannot describe I32 as the preregistered Phase-1 winner.
claim_policy.if_both_pass: Both are stable signal-informed initializations. Choose the paper framing from the direct held-out I8-versus-I32 mechanism gate, not from seed-42 ranking.
claim_policy.if_both_fail: The current P2 initialization family lacks the required training-seed stability and cannot support the main method claim.

priority_relative_to_paper_baselines: Matched standard PEFT LoRA r32 remains mandatory for a paper superiority claim. Phase-1b I32 is the mechanism-control priority; standard LoRA is the external-baseline priority. Their launch order must be chosen from compute capacity after Phase 1, not from favorable intermediate values.
researcher_degrees_of_freedom: No seed, threshold, comparison orientation, exclusion set, averaging unit, or claim-policy branch may be changed after observing seed-43/44 evaluation results.
